meta: Plan your week with AI in 10 minutes, without cramming too much into one day. Day 2 of the 7-day AI challenge.

muc.title: Day 2: a weekly plan
muc.text: Day two of seven: plan your week in ten minutes. The most common mistake is cramming too much into one day.

muc.title: Type out everything on your mind
muc.text: Type every task in your head in one go: housework, work, errands. No need to sort them.

muc.title: AI groups and orders them
muc.text: Ask AI to group similar tasks, flag the urgent ones, then spread them evenly over seven days.

muc.title: Three tasks a day, max
muc.text: The day-two rule: no more than three important tasks a day. Everything else moves to next week.

muc.title: Day 2 task
muc.text: Type all of this week's tasks into a chatbot, ask it to spread them over seven days with the three-task rule, then copy the plan into your calendar.
